parsed.rationale: Both `LCDMinOffsetKey` and `LCDMaxOffsetKey` are type-alias-objects defined in the same file (`AccentColorEnvironment.swift`) within the `PlayerHeaderView` package, just four lines apart (lines 31 and 35). Although they share structural shape (both are empty type-alias-objects with `shared_field_count: 1`), they encode semantically distinct SwiftUI `EnvironmentKey` concepts — a minimum offset and a maximum offset — whose coincidental structural identity is a natural consequence of the SwiftUI `EnvironmentKey` boilerplate pattern. Collapsing them would conflate two independent configuration axes and break call-site clarity. No refactor is warranted.
